name: ClientFlow Lite - Client Onboarding Automation
description: Client submits a form, receives a welcome email, and gets added to a Google Sheets pipeline automatically. Simple onboarding workflow.

setupVars.label: clientflow sender name (was the n8n environment variable CLIENTFLOW_SENDER_NAME)
clientflow sheet id (was the n8n environment variable CLIENTFLOW_SHEET_ID)

setup: "New Client" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value clientflowSenderName: clientflow sender name (was the n8n environment variable CLIENTFLOW_SENDER_NAME). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value clientflowSheetId: clientflow sheet id (was the n8n environment variable CLIENTFLOW_SHEET_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /clientflow-lite). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## ClientFlow Lite

Simplest onboarding: welcome email + sheet log.
No Stripe, Calendar, or Slack.
Perfect for solo freelancers.
